description: System settings for the application. This struct is used to load and save settings from a configuration file.

auto_start.description: Auto start the application on system login

listen_addr_ipv4.description: listen ipv4 address for the server to bind to

listen_addr_ipv6.description: listen ipv6 address for the server to bind to

log_cleanup_interval_hours.description: Interval in hours for the cleanup task (default 12)

log_cleanup_threshold_percent.description: Disk usage threshold for log cleanup (default 90%)

log_level.description: access logs are printed with the INFO level so ensure it is enabled by default

port.description: port number for the server to bind to

signaling_url.description: Signaling server url, if not set, it will be "ws://127.0.0.1:{port}/signaling"
